names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Ανατόλιος ο στρατηλάτης», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

The whole of the title on the name link behind the line for 23 апреля ст. ст., name page 171, «Мученик Анатолий», with the rank word left off; the page gives no city and no epithet, and the day’s line gives only the genitive «Анатолия». The form is therefore a bare forename, which folds onto `anatoly-martyr-1918`, a martyr of 1918 kept on 2 сентября ст. ст. who stores the identical string; that fold is keyed as read in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit. The icon caption on life6415, «Мч. Анатолий Никомидийский», would have given a two-word form, and it was not used: a caption is not a heading.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Анатолия и Протолеона (303).»
source.note: The day’s fifth entry, a line naming two men, of whom this is the first. The name link behind «Анатолия» is page 171, titled «Мученик Анатолий», which gives «День памяти: 23 апреля» and no other day and NO EPITHET AT ALL — so the stored form is the bare forename, and that is what makes the fold this batch had to key. The caption of the icon on his own life page, life6415, reads «Мч. Анатолий Никомидийский», giving him the city his companion’s name page gives in its title; a caption is weaker than a heading and the city was NOT written into the stored form, only recorded here and in the life. `dates` WRITTEN WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE AT ALL: the line heads the pair «(303)», which is the year of the great-martyr’s own death on this day, «Это было 23 апреля 303 года» in life918. The day page prints no hymn under his name — the four it prints are three for the great-martyr and one for the empress. Not checked: azbyka.ru.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ανατόλιος ο στρατηλάτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **George's own page carries a different feast type**: «Ειδικός υπολογισμός. Εορτάζει στις 23 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους. Εάν όμως η εορτή πέσει πρίν το Πάσχα, τότε εορτάζει την επόμενη μέρα του Πάσχα (Δευτέρα της Δικαινησίμου)» — a fixed 23 April which is transferred to Bright Monday in a year when it would fall before Pascha. The companions' own pages carry the plain fixed type. The whole body of the page is one sentence, and it is the same sentence for Anatolius and for Protoleon: that he was a soldier, that seeing George's martyrdom he confessed Christ, and that he was martyred by the sword. It gives no year, no country, no city and no judge, and prints no hymn and no relic. Protoleon's page adds one textual note of its own, that the Synaxaristes of the Dionysiou monastery reads «Ώσπερ αλκίμων λέων» in the couplet where this page has «ώσπερ αλκαία λέων». The corpus's other men of these names are on other days; none of them is a general of George's company.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru heads the line for 23 апреля ст. ст. «Мчч. Анатолия и Протолеона (303)», and life918 gives the day and year of the great-martyr he was beheaded beside — «Это было 23 апреля 303 года». He was put to the sword at once and without trial on the day of those torments, so the year is the same. The corpus’s first year of any kind for him: the folder held no `dates` object and the Greek calendar it was built from gives none.
